name: formal-theorem-proving-agent-v2
notes: Built by `agentswe setup` with images/env-builder (micromamba create --file conda-explicit.txt; pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.lock; post-build.sh). Historical in-prefix caches (.conda-pkgs, npm-cache) are not reproduced. The Lean release asset is fetched on the host by setup (resumable; AGENTSWE_BUILD_PROXY if set) and handed to the build as /spec/downloads/; its sha256 is recorded at setup and is to be pinned here once the built lean binary is confirmed identical to the paper environment's.
lean: 4.19.0 (official release unpacked into the prefix by post-build.sh)

downloads.name: lean-4.19.0-linux.tar.zst
